description: This file defines the CustomerGroup class within the Opencart admin controller namespace. The class handles event-driven modifications related to customer groups, such as adding, editing, and deleting customer groups by scheduling tasks to update system data accordingly. It extends the base Controller class and interacts with the model for task management.

classes.name: CustomerGroup
classes.description: Controller class that manages event hooks related to customer group operations, scheduling tasks for system data synchronization.

methods.name: addCustomerGroup
methods.description: Schedules tasks to update customer group list and info after a customer group is added.

methods.name: editCustomerGroup
methods.description: Schedules tasks to update customer group list and info after a customer group is edited.

methods.name: deleteCustomerGroup
methods.description: Schedules tasks to update customer group list and delete info after a customer group is deleted.
